name: Creative Writing Minor
faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students successfully complete a minimum total of 24 units, including a minimum of 15 upper division units.

requirements.title: 3 of CA 238, CA 319W, CA 338W and 30 more
Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Upper division courses counted toward the creative writing minor may not also count toward the English major, any of the English joint majors, the English minor, or the extended minor.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A cumulative grade point average of 2.0 is required in the courses used for the minor.

sections.note: Substitutions may be approved on a case-by-case basis by the student advisor or Undergraduate Chair.
